headline: Brazil Lower House Approves Government Fiscal Adjustment Bill
summary: Brazil's Lower House approved President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva's fiscal adjustment bill by a vote of 353 to 128. The measure establishes spending curbs and limits high public sector salaries.
why: Fiscal policy decisions in Brazil directly affect national public debt sustainability, sovereign borrowing costs, and foreign investment flows.

impacts.name: Brazilian Real
impacts.why: Passage of spending control legislation impacts fiscal credibility and national currency valuation.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Legislative approval of fiscal restraint measures directly alters market expectations regarding Brazil's debt deficit and interest rate trajectory.
